status: Runtime status (machine-generated): model-response time configured {total} s, consumed {consumed} s, remaining {remaining} s. Charged time is awaited model API response time, including provider and network waits. Setup and tool execution are excluded.
grouping: You may request up to {max_read_calls} independent read-only tool calls in one response. Calls run sequentially in response order. Business writes and finish_task each require a separate single-call response. A batch rejected in preflight executes no calls. A returned read error does not stop later reads. A tool timeout, cancellation or worker failure stops the attempt without retry.
invalid_arguments: Arguments must be a valid JSON object with unique keys and finite values
schema_arguments: Arguments must match the tool parameter schema. No calls in this response were executed.
mixed_write: No calls executed. Business writes require a separate single-call response.
batch_cap: No calls executed. This response exceeds the configured read-call limit.
invalid_batch: No calls executed because another call in this response failed preflight.
invalid_call_id: No calls executed. Call IDs must be nonempty unique strings and must not repeat earlier call IDs.
